task: Semantic selection and recovery for synthetic digital invoice-service offers
plannerArchitecture: Neural service/privacy/priority/supplier-outcome classification, followed by deterministic duration parsing, catalog filtering, price ranking, budget checks, and action gating.
evaluationRole: Development regression cases. These were a fresh holdout for v2; v2 outcomes informed the v3 redesign, so they are not an untouched v3 holdout.
caveats: Twelve synthetic cases are a development evaluation, not a representative production benchmark.
The keyword baseline is deliberately simple and can be improved.
No model result authorizes release of reserved capacity.
Model runs are sequential on CPU with deterministic decoding; this is not a public Reactive latency benchmark.
